source: docs/audio/backend-spike.md (E02-T01), measured 2026-11-07 on ASUSTeK ROG Strix G533QS
notes: Negotiated values only. A request that is not listed here was never measured on this endpoint, so latency_proxy fails closed instead of extrapolating.

shared.note: GetSharedModeEnginePeriod reports min = default = max = 512 frames; IAudioClient3 cannot go below it and the buffer depth is 1126 frames.

exclusive.note: The driver rejects float and clamps every requested period below 256 frames up to its 256-frame minimum; the exclusive buffer equals one period.
